user.title: Edookit login
user.description: Log in with the same account you use on your school's Edookit portal (usually a Plus4U e-mail and password).

data_description.school: Subdomain or address of your school's portal, e.g. `zs-example` or `https://zs-example.edookit.net`.
data_description.login_method: Automatic: e-mail → Plus4U password, anything else → Plus4U access codes; the classic Edookit form if the school has one.
data_description.oidc_client_id: Leave empty. Only needed if automatic Plus4U discovery fails (see README).
data_description.username: For “+4U Access” login enter access code 1 here and access code 2 as the password.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in again
reauth_confirm.description: Edookit refused the saved password for {username}. Enter the current password.

error.school_not_found: This school was not found on edookit.net.
error.invalid_auth: Login failed. Check the e-mail and password (and the login method).

data.scan_interval: Refresh interval for messages, grades and homework
data.public_api: Load public school events and substitutions
data.api_student_id: Student id for the REST API (optional)
data.travel_time: Travel time from school to home

data_description.timetable_update_time: The timetable is downloaded once a day at this time (and when Home Assistant starts or you press Refresh).
data_description.scan_interval: Minutes. Used only when smart refresh is off. 0 = only once a day together with the timetable.
data_description.timetable_source: Automatic: REST API if configured, otherwise iCal URL if set, otherwise the portal web page.
data_description.ical_url: If your school provides a calendar (iCal/ICS) link with the timetable, it is the most reliable source.
data_description.api_username: Only if your school gave you credentials for the Edookit REST API (most parents do not have them).
data_description.smart_refresh: During school, messages, grades and homework are downloaded shortly after every lesson ends; afternoons, weekends and holidays use the longer interval below; nothing is downloaded at night. When off, the fixed interval above is used.
data_description.after_lesson_delay: Minutes after the end of a lesson (teachers enter grades and notes after the lesson).
data_description.off_school_interval: Minutes between refreshes when the children are not at school.
data_description.travel_time: Minutes – used by the “Arrival home” sensor.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Download the timetable and/or other data from Edookit now.

get_timetable.name: Get timetable
get_timetable.description: Return lessons for a date range (from the loaded weeks).

end_date.name: To
end_date.description: Last day (same as From when empty).

dump_pages.name: Save portal pages (debug)
dump_pages.description: Save the HTML of all Edookit pages to /config/edookit_debug to help fix parsing. Contains personal data!
